steps: Prepare all ingredients: dice the onion, carrots, garlic and tomatoes. Dice and toast the walnuts.

Heat the olive oil in a pot on medium heat. Add the onion and saute for 2-3 minutes, stirring until fragrant. Add carrots, celery, garlic, salt, pepper and oregano. Saute for another 7-8 minutes stirring.
Add the tomato paste, brown it a little. Add the wine. Stir scraping up any bits that stuck to the bottom of the pot. When most of the wine cooked off, add tomatoes and cook them for a few minutes.
Add the lentils, veggie stock and walnuts. Bring to boil, cover and lower the heat to low. Let it simmer for 20-25 minutes. Uncover when lentils get tender.
Continue cooking uncovered until most of the liquid has cooked off. Adjust seasoning to your liking.
Serve with pasta of your liking. I recommend rigatoni pasta.

parts.title: Pico de Gallo
steps: Finely dice the tomatoes and onions or chop roughly and use food processor to dice. Do not puree.
Squeeze juice of 1 lime. Mix with the diced vegetables.
Add spices, salt and pepper to taste.
Let it sit for and hour at room temperature.

parts.title: Tacos
steps: Rinse the black beans, combine with 60g of Pico de Gallo, taco seasoning and salt. Smash or blend together until you get a thick paste.
Wrap 8 tortillas in damp paper towels, microwave on high until warm and pliable, about 30 seconds.
Arrange the tortillas on baking sheets. Spread bean mixture over 1 half of each tortilla. Top evenly with cheese. Fold the tortillas in half and gently press to ensure they stay folded.
Bake in 230 C until the tortillas are golden brown and crisp, about 15 minutes, flipping the tacos.
Serve each taco with sour cream and Pico de Gallo on top.
Heat up bullion with bay leaf and two allspice berries.
Cut potatoes into small cubes.
Onion, carrot, parsley and celery root - cut them with food processor to very small pieces or grate then on big shread.
When the bullion is warm, put all the vegetables in. Add barley, salt and pepper for taste and cook for 30 minutes.
Add beans, vegetarian cream and turmeric, let it boil again. Then turn off the heat.
If the taste is not deep enough add soy sauce.
Serve with dill and parsley.
Prepare the butter earlier - it ust be in room temperature
Preheat the oven to 180°C. Grease and flour a bread loaf pan.
Pick a couple walnuts for decoration. Coarsely chop the rest.
In a mixing bowl, cream together the softened butter and the sugar.
Mash 3 bananas with a fork until the consistency of chunky applesauce and add them to the batter along with 2 eggs, mixing until blended.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda and salt and add the mixture to the batter.
Add vanilla extract and mix in chopped walnuts.
Pour into the prepared loaf pan. Cut the last banan in half and put on top. Put the walnuts on top for decoration.
Bake at 180°C for 55-60 min or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Let banana bread rest for 10 min before transferring to a wire rack to cool.
Sift the flour with the baking powder. Add sugar.
Crack the eggs into a bowl and add a tablespoon of sugar. Beat the eggs and sugar lightly.
Add the flour and baking powder mixture and the cottage cheese to the bowl. Mix all the ingredients thoroughly with a spoon.
Fry the pancakes. Serve with jam, fruit, or peanut butter.
Cut onions into thick slices straight through. I usually get 3-4 slices per onion.
Burn both sides of the onion slices on a dry pan. They're good if they're a little charred on each side.
Cut the leak's leafs off, wash thoroughly and cut in half.
Peel the carrots, parsley root and celery root. Cut the carrot and parsley in half. Cut the celery into bigger pieces.
Put water, stock cubes, carrots, celery root, leak, garlic, burnt onions, 4 bay leaves and 4 allspice berries in a big pot. Let it boil, then put it on low heat, cover and leave to simmer for 1 hour.
Add parsley root, mushrooms, 8 pepper berries whole and cook on low heat for another 1-2 hours.
Eat with cut up cooked vegetables, pasta and parsley as for your liking or use it for a base of other soups.
Roast the frozen corn on pan.
Dice the cucumber, red pepper, onions and feta cheese into small pieces.
In a large bowl mix toghether the roasted corn, cucumber, red pepper, onion and strained black beans.
Squeeze lime juice of 1 lime and add to the bowl. Add mayo and seasoning. Mix toghether thoroughly. Taste and add more spices if needed. In te end add feta cheese, mix.
Serve with freshly diced avocado and tortilla chips.
Peels and slice the beets.
Add the beets, 2 cloves of garlic, dried mushrooms, and a bay leaf to 2 liters of broth.
Cover the pot, bring the soup to a boil, then reduce the heat so it is just simmering and cook for one hour (the beets should be tender).
Add marjoram 10 minutes before the end of cooking.
Once cooked, strain the borscht, add a tablespoon of sugar and a tablespoon of vinegar, and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Mix flour, eggs, milk, 250ml water, oil and pinch of salt with mixer
Heat up a pan. It must be hot.
Fry the pancakes: pour a thin laer of the batter into a pan, wait until the edges lift, then fry the pancake on the other side.

parts.title: Pancakes
steps: Mix flour, eggs, milk, 250ml water, oil and pinch of salt with mixer
Heat up a pan. It must be hot.
Fry the pancakes: pour a thin laer of the batter into a pan, wait until the edges lift, then fry the pancake on the other side.

parts.title: Filling
steps: Drain 300g of sauerkraut thoroughly. Cook it with a glass of water and a teaspoon of sugar. Bring it to boil covered, then ucover and let it simmer on low heat for 25 minutes. Drain the water and let the cabbage cool.
When cooled, squeeye out the remaining water and shred it.
Grate the mushrooms using a coarse grater or dice into very small pieces in food processor.
Dice the onion and sauté it in oil until translucent. Add the mushrooms and sauté over low heat for about 20 minutes until the liquid has evaporated.
Add the cabbage, stir, and sauté for another 10 minutes. Leave it to cool.
Grate cheese and mix it in the filling with salt, paprika and pepper.
Assemble the krokiety: Put 2-3 spoons of the filling in the centre of the pancake in a cylindric shape (similarly to a burrito). Fold the sides and roll.
Coat each roll in flour, egg and breadcrumbs, then fry on all sides.
Traditionally they are served with a cup of barszcz soup, but can be eaten separately too.
